Description.note: Written in Hebrew, this newspaper clipping from Yedioth Ahronoth is an article attacking the play "Mahjoub, Mahjoub" under the title "After Watching a Palestinian Theatrical Performance, Orna Sapir Arranges for Kibbutz Theater to Perform in London." The article tells the story of Orna Sapir, an Israeli young woman who watched a performance of El-Hakawati's play "Mahjoub, Mahjoub" in London but was displeased with the portrayal of Palestinian life under Occupation.
